message.content: In July, specifically during two occasions, Hailey Johnson sought feedback from Li Hua. Firstly, in the interaction dated July 12 at 16:00, Hailey inquired about Li Hua's opinion on the new artisanal donuts she had been working on. Secondly, on July 31 at 13:00, Hailey invited Li Hua to assist in gathering feedback from customers for an upcoming bread-tasting event. These interactions demonstrate that Hailey values Li Hua's input and seeks her opinions on various new products and events.
